verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API is described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document (v1.0.2), which can be retrieved from ReadMe's api-registry endpoint behind developers.fellow.ai, along with llms.txt and per-page .md mirrors. However, there is no Fellow-branded download path: openapi.json, swagger.json and .well-known paths on developers.fellow.ai all return 404, so getting the spec depends on a third-party registry URL that Fellow does not advertise. Missing for 10: a documented, Fellow-hosted spec download link; evidence that the spec download is advertised to users; independent or hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and current.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Fellow's Developer API is described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document
the stable URL is ReadMe's api-registry endpoint
